technique_name: Design an algorithm for searching for duplicate contact entries in a list of emails.
description: The algorithm should first read each email address to determine if the address is unique or a duplicate of an existing address. To ensure accuracy, the data should be broken down into tokens based on the local-part (before the @) and the domain-part (after the @). Then, these tokens can be compared to other email addresses in the list to identify duplicates.
